pages.title: White House summit on Ukraine peace

facts.text: When: August 2025 — US President Donald Trump hosted European leaders and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the White House
facts.head: News

facts.text: Preceded by: Trump–Vladimir Putin meeting in Alaska
facts.head: News

facts.text: Europe: plans a European-led "reassurance force"; seeks US security guarantees as NATO membership ruled out for Ukraine
facts.head: News

facts.text: US: Europe the "first line of defence"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Russia: demands control over Donbas; willing to freeze the southern frontline
facts.head: News

facts.text: War began: February 2022
facts.head: News

pages.title: India rejects Nepal's objection on Lipulekh trade

facts.text: Issue: India–China agreed to resume border trade via Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand); Nepal objected
facts.head: News

facts.text: India: claims "not based on historical facts", unilateral — MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal
facts.head: News

facts.text: Nepal claim: Kalapani, Limpiyadhura, Lipulekh east of Mahakali River — in its constitutional map
facts.head: News

facts.text: Former Nepal PM: K.P. Sharma Oli (CPN-UML) — would "take back" territories through dialogue
facts.head: News

facts.text: Trade via Lipulekh began: 1954; disrupted by COVID-19
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Location: Pithoragarh district, tri-junction India–Nepal–China (Tibet)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Dispute root: origin of Mahakali River — India: near Kalapani; Nepal: near Limpiyadhura
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Treaty: Sugauli Treaty (1815)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Declared: 18 August 2025 by WHO — Nepal eliminated rubella as a public health problem
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Nepal first in WHO South-East Asia Region to adopt a laboratory algorithm for rubella surveillance
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2012; Step: rubella vaccine campaign (children 9 months–15 years)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2016; Step: second dose in routine immunisation
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: Early 2024; Step: over 95% children got at least one dose
facts.head: News

facts.text: Rubella: German measles; can cause Congenital Rubella Syndrome (CRS) — ~1,00,000 infants a year globally
facts.head: Background

facts.text: MMR vaccine: two doses (⚠ not three)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: 2022: 17,865 rubella cases in 78 countries
facts.head: Background

facts.text: 2024: 14.3 million children missed all vaccines; DTP3 85%; measles first dose 84%
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Immunization Agenda 2030
facts.head: Background

pages.title: India–Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement — a decade on

facts.text: Item: Agreement; Detail: Land Boundary Agreement (LBA) 2015
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Enclaves after Partition; Detail: over 160 (Chitmahals)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Indian enclaves in Bangladesh; Detail: 111 → transferred to Bangladesh
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Bangladeshi enclaves in India; Detail: 51 (Cooch Behar, West Bengal) → merged into India
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: New Indian citizens; Detail: 14,854 residents — none opted for Bangladesh
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Migrated to India; Detail: 922 from Indian enclaves in Bangladesh
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Exchange day; Detail: 31 July — once celebrated as "Independence Day"
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: ⚠ 111 Indian enclaves went to Bangladesh, 51 Bangladeshi enclaves came to India
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Issues: no land registration, no PM-Kisan; Banglar Awas Yojana gives only ₹1.3 lakh
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Visit: PM Modi to Japan, then China (SCO summit, Tianjin) — late August 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Japan's pledge: ¥10 trillion (~$68 billion) over the next decade
